title: Meta plans AI pendant, 'wearables for work' in hardware boost, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 计划推出人工智能挂件和“工作可穿戴设备”以增强硬件实力
summary: Meta Platforms plans to start testing an AI pendant in the next ‌year, as it charts a roadmap for ‌wearable devices in an effort to reverse losses in its ​hardware division, The Information reported on Friday, citing a memo. • Meta declined to comment to Reuters on the report.
summary_zh: 据《The Information》周五援引一份备忘录报道，Meta Platforms 计划在明年开始测试人工智能吊坠，同时为可穿戴设备制定路线图，以扭转其硬件部门的损失。 • Meta拒绝就该报告向路透社发表评论。

title: Social media companies pay $27 million to settle Kentucky school district’s lawsuit over social media harms, records show
title_zh: 记录显示，社交媒体公司支付 2700 万美元和解肯塔基州学区关于社交媒体危害的诉讼
summary: By Diana Novak Jones May 29 (Reuters) - A Kentucky school district secured approximately $27 million in settlements from social media companies over claims they fueled a student mental‑health crisis,
summary_zh: 戴安娜·诺瓦克·琼斯 (Diana Novak Jones) 5 月 29 日报道（路透社）——肯塔基州的一个学区从社交媒体公司获得了约 2700 万美元的和解金，理由是这些公司助长了学生的心理健康危机。

title: Social media companies to pay $27 million to settle Kentucky school district's lawsuit, records show
title_zh: 记录显示社交媒体公司支付 2700 万美元和解肯塔基州学区诉讼
summary: A Kentucky school district secured roughly $27 million in settlements from Meta Platforms and other social media companies over claims they fueled a student mental‑health crisis, according to records seen by Reuters on Friday.
summary_zh: 据路透社周五看到的记录显示，肯塔基州的一个学区从 Meta Platforms 和其他社交媒体公司获得了约 2700 万美元的和解金，理由是这些公司助长了学生的心理健康危机。

title: Why did a Blue Origin rocket explode and is it a blow to the sector?
title_zh: 为什么蓝色起源火箭会爆炸？这对该行业是一个打击吗？
summary: STORY: :: NASASpaceflight.comAn uncrewed rocket from space company Blue Origin was swallowed by a fireball on its Florida launchpad on Thursday.No one was hurt when the New Glenn rocket exploded during a hot-fire test – but it's a major blow to Jeff Bezos as he chases Elon Mus...
summary_zh: 故事：:: NASASpaceflight.com 周四，蓝色起源太空公司的一枚无人驾驶火箭在佛罗里达州发射台上被火球吞没。新格伦火箭在热火测试中爆炸，没有人受伤，但这对追逐埃隆·穆斯的杰夫·贝索斯来说是一个重大打击……

title: Nvidia, AMD, & other chip names in focus at Computex 2026
title_zh: Nvidia、AMD 和其他芯片品牌在 Computex 2026 上成为焦点
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) exhibition, Computex, is kicking off in Taipei on Jun. 2, with names like Nvidia (NVDA), AMD (AMD), Intel (INTC), and Qualcomm (QCOM) taking center stage. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what you need to know.
summary_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 展览会 Computex 将于 6 月 2 日在台北拉开帷幕，Nvidia (NVDA)、AMD (AMD)、英特尔 (INTC) 和高通 (QCOM) 等公司占据中心舞台。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 解释了您需要了解的内容。

title: 'Volatility equals opportunity' in options trades as tech soars
title_zh: 随着科技股的飙升，期权交易的“波动性等于机会”
summary: The latest earnings season has pushed the stock market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) to new highs yet again, especially on the back of heightened AI demand and adoption.
summary_zh: 最新的财报季将股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）再次推向新高，特别是在人工智能需求和采用增加的背景下。

title: Dell stock unexpectedly booms on AI demand: What investors may have missed
title_zh: 戴尔股票因人工智能需求而意外上涨：投资者可能错过了什么
summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock is up 30% in Friday trading after reporting first quarter results yesterday that topped earnings estimates, including AI server revenue of $60 billion.
summary_zh: 戴尔科技公司 (DELL) 昨天公布的第一季度业绩超出了盈利预期，其中人工智能服务器收入达 600 亿美元，该股周五交易中上涨 30%。

title: The difference between on-prem AI vs. data centers
title_zh: 本地人工智能与数据中心之间的区别
summary: While Dell Technologies (DELL) stock surges by 30% in Friday trading after reporting first quarter earnings boosted by AI server sales, what exactly does it mean for a company to run "on-prem" AI — or on-premises — as opposed to running it through a traditional AI data center?
summary_zh: 虽然戴尔科技公司 (DELL) 公布人工智能服务器销售推动第一季度收益后，其股价在周五交易中飙升 30%，但对于一家公司来说，运行“本地”人工智能（或内部部署）而不是通过传统的人工智能数据中心运行到底意味着什么？

title: Dell, Cisco: How 'throwback' tech stocks fit into the AI trade
title_zh: 戴尔、思科：“复古”科技股如何融入人工智能行业
summary: B. Riley Wealth chief market strategist Art Hogan and Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré chat with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about where "throwback" tech stocks, like Dell (DELL) and Cisco (CSCO), fit into the artificial intelligence (AI) trade.
summary_zh: B. Riley Wealth 首席市场策略师 Art Hogan 和雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 与雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 讨论了戴尔 (DELL) 和思科 (CSCO) 等“复古”科技股如何融入人工智能 (AI) 行业。
